events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Nell: I’m still catching up, but it sounds like the repair drive is really coming together. If it still needs tools and supplies, I can keep an ear out for what’s missing.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Rey: That’d help a lot. Oren says the front gate should come first, and Gus can bring a wrench set and screwdriver.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Nell: Good to know — I’ll keep that in mind and pass it along. If I hear of any other tools or supplies, I’ll let you know.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Hana: Got it — Rey should stay at the front gate first, and Faye will bring the clipboard and pens. Mina has the repair list, and Jules will point neighbors to the same details.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll stay at the front gate and keep an eye out there. Oren said that gate needs fixing first, and Gus can bring the wrench set and screwdriver.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Hana: Thanks, that matches what I have so far. I’ll keep the gate first and note that Oren flagged it, and Gus is bringing the wrench set and screwdriver.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Oren: Right, the sign-up list and a quick sweep of the tool table are still needed. Rey’s checking the front gate first, and Bo and Cleo are already helping out.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Rey: I’ll take a look at the front gate first. Then I can check what’s left on the tool table.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey—that’d help a lot. Once you’ve looked, we can finish up the sign-up list and give the tool table a quick sweep.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of where the donated tools get dropped off so nothing gets lost. That way we can move through the repair drive smoothly.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal. I’ll head to the front gate and keep an eye on the repair drive there.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Opal: Great, I’ll note the gate as your spot so the drop-offs stay coordinated. If anything gets moved, I’ll keep the locations updated.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supply list updated and I’m still tracking what we need for the repair drive. If you spot anything missing after checking the front gate, let me know and I’ll add it.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll check the front gate and let you know if I spot anything missing.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Rey. I’ll keep the list current, and if Rosa or Vik shares any updates, I’ll note those too.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Leo: I’ll send the repair drive schedule as soon as it’s set. Then folks can plan around it.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye on the front gate for now. Let me know when the schedule is ready.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send it over as soon as it’s set.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Nell: I’m still catching up, but I heard the list is current right now. I can check around for the latest list and pass along anything new.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Rey: Yeah, that sounds right — the drive’s still at the front gate for now. If you hear anything new, just pass it along.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything new I find.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Rey: It’s still at the front gate for now. I’ll keep an eye on it and let Quinn know if anything changes.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rey—keep me posted. I’m still spreading the repair drive details, and I’ll let the neighbors know it’s at the list right now.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Will do — it’s still at the front gate, and I’ll keep you posted if anything shifts.
events.speaker: Rey
